caption: The drawing features a single ceramic pitcher with a handle, depicted in earthy brown tones. The body of the pitcher is decorated with darker brown patterns, including stylized leaves and floral motifs, as well as bands of dots and wavy lines. The design covers both the upper and lower sections of the vessel. The background is a plain, light beige with no other objects present, and the focus remains entirely on the intricately decorated pitcher. The handle is attached to the upper part of the body, curving smoothly to just below the pitcher’s rim. The artwork is signed "H. MORAN" near the bottom right edge of the image.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
